title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Write-Off History and the Tier Allowed at Review
content:
**Write-off allowance (Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan tier review).** The allowance rests on the plan's latest write-off:

- when none stands, or its entry date falls after the payday or more than 365 calendar days before it, the allowance is Paystride Access Premier Plus;
- when it falls 181 to 365 days before the payday, Paystride Access Preferred;
- when it falls on the payday or up to 180 days before it, only Paystride Access Starter.

Only the latest write-off on the plan is read; earlier write-offs do not enter.

| Latest write-off's entry date | Highest tier allowed |
|---|---|
| none on the plan | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| after the payday | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| more than 365 days before the payday | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| 181 to 365 days before the payday | Paystride Access Preferred |
| on the payday or 1 to 180 days before it | Paystride Access Starter only |

## Boundaries (counted in calendar days before the payday)

- 180 days before: Paystride Access Starter only; 181 days before: Paystride Access Preferred.
- 365 days before: Paystride Access Preferred; 366 days before: Paystride Access Premier Plus.
- On the payday itself: Paystride Access Starter only.
